$comment: M44 spec 05, used by the nightly lab (M56 spec 10). The commands the lab may send to an agent while it walks the agent's own slash menu. A command on `safe` only shows a screen: a dialog the lab closes with Escape, or one line of output. It starts no model turn, writes no setting of the person and installs nothing. `opens` says what the lab expects: `dialog` (a screen that must never read as a free box) or `inline` (a line of output, then a free box). A command the agent lists that is on neither list is reported as unclassified and is never sent. A command on `unsafe` is never sent. Add a command here only after you opened it by hand in a throwaway session and saw what it does. The lists cover Claude Code. Another harness has no entry, and the lab walks no slash command there.

safe.reason: A read-only panel of account, model and settings.
The model picker. The lab closes it with Escape and never confirms a model.
The effort slider. The lab closes it with Escape and never confirms a level.
Prints the context use as output.
The permission rules. The lab adds no rule.
The memory picker. The lab closes it with Escape and opens no file.
The lab starts Claude with an empty MCP config, so Claude prints that no server is set up. It opens no list.
The theme picker. The lab closes it with Escape and never confirms a theme.
The plugin browser. The lab installs nothing.
The session list. The lab resumes nothing.
The checkpoint list. The lab closes it with Escape and restores nothing.
A read-only list of release notes.
The sandbox mode picker. The lab closes it with Escape and never confirms a mode.
Prints the running agents as output.

unsafe.reason: An account setting kept on the server. The dialog can change it, so the walk never opens it.
Rewrites the conversation and starts a model turn.
Starts a model turn and writes a file.
Opens the settings and writes them on a toggle.
A skill: it starts a model turn that runs shell commands.
Reads and writes another agent's config.
Opens an account page and changes a plan.
Writes a file and opens an editor.
